svg.title: The scheduler node and its ROS interfaces
svg.desc: Dispatch calls the plan service; SchedulerRos forwards to scheduler::Scheduler::Plan. The scheduler calls back into /central services to request follow-up jobs and publishes version info and a report every 5 s.
